title: Archons
html_source:
Archons of Athens : Athenian magistrates who condemned Socrates to death. Socrates was an unpopular figure, to say the least and when the opportunity arose he was sentenced to death for failure to acknowledge the city’s Gods.
Plato is a significant source for this history.
